items.title: Taking control of agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with Dataiku
items.summary: As agent estates grow from a handful of pilots to hundreds of agents in production, teams need to decide which agents to stop and which to promote. This post shows how Dataiku Agent Management works with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Amazon CloudWatch to discover, monitor, and control agents, using the signals AgentCore already emits.
items.creator: Ankit Mathur

items.title: Simplifying AWS Outposts Operations at Scale with CloudPrimus
items.summary: As AWS Outposts deployments scale across multiple teams and customers, platform teams must share a finite pool of compute and storage without turning each request into a manual ticket. This post explores how a cloud management platform can turn a shared Outpost into governed, self-service cloud infrastructure. It covers tenant lifecycle, self-service provisioning, per-tenant capacity and quota management, role-based access, and consolidated billing across your Outpost and the parent AWS Region. It shows how CloudPrimus helps allocate capacity to each account that needs it, while preserving governance and auditability. This helps provide a consistent multi-account operating model that complements native AWS capabilities.
items.creator: Sumeeth Siriyur
